summary: Two hikers and their dog got lost on the Devil's Head Trail in Pike National Forest after wandering off the designated path; Douglas County SAR sent a foot search party at about 4:15 p.m. and deployed a drone over the treetops, locating the group in just over two hours, all uninjured
location: Devil's Head Trail, Pike National Forest
notes: Incident date pinned to Thursday 2017-06-15 via The Drive 2017-06-20 story ("lost last Thursday"); CBS Denver and ABC News originals cited by story; dog accompanied the pair (victims=2 people)
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Douglas County, Colorado, United States)
